name: Get banner details
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the banner information shown on the Automation Advanced page, such as the marketing email status, profile completeness flag, and any account warning message. Use the automation overview endpoint instead when you need broader automation dashboard data.

marketing_email_status.description: Current status of marketing emails for the account (e.g., "enabled" or "disabled").

is_profile_complete.description: Flag indicating whether the account profile is complete (1 for complete, 0 for incomplete).

err_msg.description: Localized warning or error message associated with the banner, if any.
